hero.title: We turn your ideas into top-tier software
hero.subtitle: At PixNetMX we create and develop technological solutions that project your business into the digital future.

services.title: Our Services
services.websiteDesignDesc: We build all kinds of websites and platforms: landings, corporate portals, promotional pages and more.
services.websiteDesignFull: Your website represents the heart of your digital presence. At PixNetMX we go beyond appearance to create interactive experiences that captivate your visitors and drive them to act.
services.styleGuideDesc: Before development, we forge your digital identity. We know your visual image is key, so we craft a style guide to unify all your platforms and applications.
services.contentStrategyDesc: Even the most powerful software needs visibility. Our content strategy aims to position your company as a knowledge leader in the technology industry.
services.webDevDesc: We develop web platforms and mobile apps of any kind. If you already have a design, we turn it into a functional product.
services.customCreationDesc: When standard options fall short, you need a solution tailored to you. We specialize in developing custom software, ensuring that every functionality and line of code responds to your operations and future goals.
services.premadeTemplateDesc: Perfect for businesses seeking a professional platform without investing the time and cost of an entirely custom project. We select, adapt and install premium templates, verified and tuned for optimal performance. You combine fast delivery with PixNetMX's technical rigor.
services.maintenanceDesc: Launching your software is just the beginning. We provide a comprehensive maintenance and support service so your applications remain fast, secure and up-to-date as technology evolves.

about.title: About Us
about.content: PixNetMX is a firm focused on customized digital solutions, with emphasis on web development, mobile apps, user experience and system integration. We help companies, entrepreneurs and brands build their digital image, streamline their processes and effectively connect with their audience. We stand out for delivering everything from affordable and functional landings to robust applications, always adapting to each requirement and budget.

mission.title: Mission
mission.content: To empower companies and entrepreneurs with cutting-edge, affordable and scalable technological tools that strengthen their digital presence, add value and enhance the user experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: To position ourselves as leaders in the digital field of Mexico and Latin America, valued for our excellence, creativity and competitive pricing, supporting the technological modernization of businesses of any scale.

values.title: Values
values.innovation: Innovation: We constantly explore alternatives to improve the digital environment.
values.commitment: Commitment: We achieve the goals of those who trust us with responsibility and dedication.
values.quality: Quality: We deliver stable, secure and high-performance projects.
values.accessibility: Accessibility: We offer flexible plans that adapt to different budgets.
values.collaboration: Collaboration: We work alongside our clients to achieve customized solutions.
values.transparency: Transparency: We openly explain each phase of the work and the associated costs.

distinguish.title: What Sets Us Apart
distinguish.content: At PixNetMX we bring together a group of professionals dedicated to custom system development and design. With industry experience, we generate digital products that exceed our clients' expectations. We are guided by open communication, teamwork and the delivery of impeccable results. We trust that properly conceived software can streamline operations, provide tangible benefits and uncover new business opportunities. We accompany you from the original idea to implementation and ongoing support.

objective.title: Our Objective
objective.content: To provide businesses of any size with creative, flexible and high-performance software solutions that boost their expansion and advantage in the digital environment.
objective.subtitle: To be the preferred technology choice for organizations that value quality, innovation and reliability in software design and development.

hero.title: Website Design & Development
hero.content: PixNetMX offers a comprehensive catalog of design and development solutions and packages, aimed at solving your specific needs and exploiting the advantages of the digital world.

uxuiBasic.title: Basic UX/UI Interface Design
uxuiBasic.desc: Prototype development, visual sketches and style guidelines.

uxuiStandard.title: UX/UI Interface Design
uxuiStandard.desc: Prototypes, mockups, style manual, user testing and adjustments for different devices.

uxuiRedesign.title: Interface Redesign / UX Improvement
uxuiRedesign.desc: Analysis of current platform, optimization suggestions, user testing and visual renewal.

webStatic.title: Web Development – Static Corporate Site
webStatic.desc: Fixed sections (Home, About Us, Services, Contact) mobile-friendly, without complex backend.

webDynamic.title: Web Development – Dynamic Site / CMS
webDynamic.desc: CMS integration (WordPress, Joomla…), forms, control panel and content management.

ecommerce.title: Basic E-commerce
ecommerce.desc: Product display, shopping cart, payment gateway, shipping logistics and customer profiles.

appSimple.title: Simple Mobile Application
appSimple.desc: Basic hybrid or native application, essential features, API connection and limited visual design.

appComplex.title: Intermediate / Complex Mobile Application
appComplex.desc: More screens, use of device functionalities, location, push notifications and more elaborate design.

apiIntegration.title: API / External Services Integration
apiIntegration.desc: Basic connection with external services: payments, geolocation, maps and other systems.

landingUltra.title: Ultra Basic Landing Page
landingUltra.desc: Single-section page with contact details or limited-time campaign.

pageSimple.title: Simple Informative Page
pageSimple.desc: Up to two screens (Home), responsive, with modified template.

digitalCard.title: Digital Card / Mini Landing
digitalCard.desc: Single screen with QR code, brand identity, contact methods and social networks.

landingPromo.title: Promotional Landing
landingPromo.desc: Site with registration form, responsive design and email connection.

onePage.title: Professional One Page
onePage.desc: Single-block page with sections: home, services, testimonials, contact.

catalog.title: Online Catalog without Payment
catalog.desc: Displays items or services with search engine and information cards, without purchase option.

blog.title: Professional Blog
blog.desc: CMS-based setup (WordPress), topic classification, browser and comment space.

institutional.title: Institutional Site with up to 5 Pages
institutional.desc: Home, Corporate Profile, Services, News, Contact; with mobile device adaptation.
